conjecture: (Q) For the unit I of a closed symmetric monoidal C with small coproducts, does C(I,-) preserving all COPOWERS kappa.I (the one-parameter test gamma_kappa: kappa x End(I) -> C(I,kappa.I) iso) imply C(I,-) preserves ALL small coproducts (I connected)? This is the follow-on gap to flagship T1 (fullness-unit-connectedness): T1's necessity is stated on copowers, its sufficiency on all coproducts; (Q) asks whether the copower test certifies fullness. RESULT: (A) copower-of-unit preservation <=> the induced Set-monad T=C(I,(-).I) of the copower adjunction (-).I -| C(I,-) is the WRITER MONAD (-)xM, M=End(I) commutative; and (C) all-coproduct preservation <=> the Eilenberg-Moore comparison K:C->M-Set, K(X)=(C(I,X), precomposition), preserves coproducts. UPGRADE under extensivity: extensive C => (A)<=>(B)<=>(C)<=> I indecomposable & non-initial, so the copower test decides fullness over EVERY extensive base (Set, presheaf/Grothendieck toposes, Set x Set). Additive/pointed/thin bases FAIL (A) already; Day/gluing bases satisfy both; so no standard base separates. Raw (A)=>(C) without extensivity reduced to 'K preserves coproducts', obstruction = a mixed point not lifting through coprod_t eps_{X_t}; existence of a non-extensive separator (Q') left OPEN.

Extensivity Thm via the decomposition formula C(I,coprod X_t)=coprod_{decomps} prod C(A_t,X_t): (A) forbids nontrivial decompositions of I (a nontrivial I=A0+A1 gives a map not in im(gamma_2)), forcing I indecomposable+non-initial=connected. Lemma 1.1-1.2: (-).I -| C(I,-) always (C(S.I,X)=Set(S,C(I,X))); F=(-).I is STRONG symmetric monoidal from (Set,x) (using (S.I)(x)(S'.I)=(SxS').I via tensor cocontinuity + I(x)I=I), U=C(I,-) lax monoidal, M=End(I) commutative (Eckmann-Hilton). A monoidal adjunction.

Theorem 1.3 (Reduction A): (A) copowers-of-I preserved <=> the induced Set-monad T=UF=C(I,(-).I) is the WRITER MONAD (-)xM for M=End(I). Unit s|->(s,id_I), mult via monoid product. Explains why disconnected bases fail (A) not merely (C): a zero object makes T(kappa) carry sums.

Theorem 2.2 (Reduction B): EM(writer (-)xM)=M-Set; comparison K:C->M-Set, K(X)=(C(I,X), precomposition by End(I)); U=forgetful.K and forgetful M-Set->Set CREATES colimits, so under (A): (C) <=> K preserves all coproducts. K always preserves copowers of I (=exactly (A)). So (Q) becomes: K preserving one family (copowers of I) => K preserves all coproducts?

Lemma 2.3 + Rem 2.4: gamma_{(X_t)} = U(e).eta_A with e=coprod_t eps_{X_t}: (coprod_t C(I,X_t)).I -> coprod_t X_t. So U(e) surjective => gamma surjective. Single-object counit eps_X has U(eps_X) split epi in Set (via eta) so points always lift for ONE object; but eta is a Set-map not a C-map, so coprod_t eps_{X_t} need not be U-surjective -- THE EXACT CRACK: a mixed point I->coprod X_t not lifting = gamma non-surjective with (A) still holding.

Theorem 3.1 (THE DELIVERABLE): C extensive => (A)<=>(B)<=>(C)<=> I indecomposable & non-initial <=> I connected. Proof: (A)=>I non-initial (else C(I,kappa.I)=1!=kappa); (A)=>I indecomposable via the extensive decomposition formula C(I,coprod X_t)=coprod_{I=coprod A_t} prod_t C(A_t,X_t): a nontrivial decomposition I=A0+A1 yields a map I->I+I outside im(gamma_2) (disjointness), contradicting (A); then indecomposable+non-initial => connected. Discharges (Q) for every extensive base. Cor 3.2: Set, presheaf/Grothendieck toposes, Set x Set all decided by the one-parameter copower test.

OPEN (Q'): does a NON-extensive closed symmetric monoidal base satisfy (A) but fail (C)? Equivalent (Thm 2.2) to K:C->M-Set preserving copowers of I but not all coproducts; obstruction = mixed point non-lifting through coprod eps (Rem 2.4). Necessary conditions on any separator: non-extensive, non-additive/no-zero, non-thin, I not a strong generator -- ruling out every standard base. Sufficient conditions making (A)=>(C): {extensive; U monadic; I strong generator coproduct-projective}. Assessment: closedness controls maps OUT of coproducts (vacuous) not INTO them, so no monoidal a-priori reason for the upgrade -- expect a separator to exist in some exotic base but NOT constructed. Honest boundary.
